This app does the trick without a bunch of other extraneous features. I like the concept of being reminded to take photos of my pets as well, and the app has customization for every species of pet you could ever own.

I love this app - I have multiple rescue pets and keeping track of everyone mentally is tough. plus, having this data helps at vet appointments. I love that you can add photos, events of any kind (medication, walk in the park, bath) and health metrics like weight and vomit/diarrhea. very grateful for this app, I've been telling a lot of folks about it!

Awesome little free app to track all my pets' weights. It also tracks their ages down to the month (or week depending on age). I got it to keep better track of the weights of my pets so they can lose the couple of pounds recommended by the vet, but not be underweight either. Or just maintain their weight. I haven't really started using any other features like the records, vaccinations, reminders, calendar, etc. but I think it would be smart to do for myself if I started using them lol
